# Degree Explorer (see issue #1409): the canonical pages stay crawlable, but
# filter, sort and pagination query strings generate a near-unbounded URL space.
# The trailing '?' anchors each rule to the query variants only -- dropping it
# would also block the canonical page.
Disallow: /degree-explorer?
Disallow: /degree-explorer/list?
Disallow: /degree-explorer/a-z?
Disallow: /degree-explorer/compare?
